page.overview:
Who is Duga?

Duga grew up poor, but joined the Fire Navy to hone his firebending abilities. He was mercilessly bullied by fellow crewmates who did not understand his amazing gift due to his sensitive nature, and ended up deserting to escape the torment. Rather than return home a failure, Duga swore to make something of himself and joined up with a crew of pirates the first chance he got.

The young man proved himself invaluable to the crew of the Burning Wave by setting merchant boats alight with his bending while the pirates plundered to their hearts' content. Duga slowly worked his way through the ranks until he was first mate, when he then bit his tongue as the captain squandered the wealth they stole. Eventually, the foolish former captain died on an expedition, leaving Duga in charge.

Waiting for the moment his entire life, Duga set about changing the Burning Wave for the better. He soon won the loyalty of his crew, who doubted his leadership skills at first, but grew to cherish their captain as their pockets grew heavy with coin. Under Duga's leadership, the Burning Wave made more money than any other Crimson Sails pirate faction during the Hundred Year War by also dabbling in mercantile pursuits, but they only shared the bare minimum with the Armada. Their greed made them an object of scorn on Crimson Sails, but enterprising pirates who actually wanted to make a profit knew that Duga and the Burning Wave were their best shot.

Duga used to have a good working relationship with Tengfei, leader of the Renegade Phoenix, and some even said that the two were in love. However, the relationship soured when Duga left Tengfei stranded on a mission, because she was caught by guards. Some would have made the choice to go back for her, but Duga placed profit above any loyalty he had toward a fellow pirate. Crews of the Burning Wave and the Renegade Phoenix came to blame one another for more than a few blundered missions, and they continued to clash after the war was over.
